thread:
Mira: quick sanity check — new int8_rerank_v2 run on webqa looks worse vs fp16. ndcg@10 0.318 vs baseline 0.335. anyone else seeing this?
Ajay: saw a blip, can you paste the eval config?
Mira: sure, here's the job header
Mira: ```eval_suite: webqa_v2
model: int8_rerank_v2
batch_size: 64
ctx_pad: 128
metric: ndcg@10,mrr```
Leo: did you use the same candidate preproc? sometimes tokenization/truncation changes kill rerank scores.
Mira: same pipeline afaict — we use candidate_stem_v3. But I noticed we switched to sentencepiece v1.2 in the build for int8.
Sasha: that could shift token boundaries. small shift -> changed doc chunking -> ordering changes -> ndcg drop.
Ajay: can we diff token counts for top candidates between runs? quick script: ```python -c "# compare token lengths for top K; load_runs(a,b)"```
Mira: ran a quick diff — ~12% of docs have differing token counts in top10. average +4 tokens.
eval-bot: run-2723456789 completed: ndcg@10=0.318, mrr=0.421, samples=12,345
Leo: also check whether kv-cache packing or anchor-kv packing changed for int8. that sometimes affects scoring if candidate representations differ slightly.
Mira: good call. I also saw some examples where the original query was truncated differently after whitespace normalization change.
Sasha: hmm dataset selection too: are we still using webqa_v2-holdout? we recently added a small english-only filter on fp16 eval but not on int8 runs.
Mira: argh — that's probably it. fp16 eval used webqa_v2_hol_english, int8 used webqa_v2_hol_all. mixing splits.
Ajay: that would explain a systematic delta. recompute int8 on the english-only holdout ASAP.
Mira: enqueueing new eval now, should finish in ~10m.
eval-bot: queued run-2723456798 (int8_rerank_v2 on webqa_v2_hol_english)
ops-bot: infra note: int8 cluster autoscaled for eval, no issues.
Mira: new run done — ndcg@10=0.333, mrr=0.429. much closer to fp16. still small gap but within expected variance.
Leo: okay good. still want to audit tokenizer change and candidate_stem_v3 interaction for a couple samples. can you dump top10 for 5 mismatch cases?
Mira: dumping now to gdrive: <link to snippets>
Sasha: let's add a presubmit check: block int8 evals if tokenization version != baseline_tokenizer in eval metadata. small automation to prevent future split mismatches.
Ajay: +1. also add a note in the bring-up checklist: verify eval split and tokenizer parity.
Mira: created ticket #INF-4123 and added checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
Leo: nice recovery. closing this thread unless more regressions pop up.
Mira: closing, but leaving artifacts in the ticket.
